annotations.title: Ask for a field, provider, condition or plan to be covered

description: Use this when: a search or check of API plans came back empty or mostly unknown, or the user asks about a field, provider, condition or plan this service does not cover, and you want it to be considered. Do not use this when: plans were found (use them), or to ask a question (nothing is answered). Leave one short line: kind, name and an optional reason. No personal information: it takes no name, e-mail or link and refuses them. It is kept in the server log only and has no reply. Example: 1 search with 3 required conditions came back with 0 plans, and the user needs a condition that is not recorded.

kind.description: What is missing: field (a kind of API not compared here), provider, condition (a field of a plan we do not record), plan, or other.

name.description: The field, provider, condition or plan, as a short name (at most 80 characters). Not a person's name or contact detail.

reason.description: Optional. Why it is needed, in one short sentence (at most 200 characters). No personal information.
